kits.name: 808 classic
kits.description: The analog machine as it left the factory, every knob near its middle: round kick, snappy snare, ticking hats, congas and the cowbell.

kits.name: Jazz sticks
kits.description: A small jazz kit played with sticks in a club room: a deep snare from whisper to crack, a breathing ride, a flat ride and a sizzle.

kits.name: Funk studio
kits.description: A dry studio kit for funk and soul: a tight half-muted snare that loves ghost notes, a short kick, crisp hats, no room.

kits.name: Dusty
kits.description: The jazz kit heard through a 1950s microphone: warm, worn and mid-heavy, made for boom bap and lo-fi beats.

kits.name: Rock
kits.description: An early-80s kit hit hard: a damped 24-inch kick, a deep snare with rimshots, four toms and a full set of cymbals, a china among them.

kits.name: Mallets
kits.description: The rock kit played with soft mallets: booming toms and cymbals that swell and wash, for film and ambient music.

kits.name: Brushes
kits.description: A kit played with brushes in a small room: snare hits, digs and stirs, a soft kick, and cymbals that hiss and shimmer.

kits.name: Indie
kits.description: A kit with snare wires on every drum: a buzzing kick, snares turned into toms, a loose hat and trashy cymbals. Garage and indie rock.

kits.name: 70s soul
kits.description: A kit recorded for a 1973 sound: a deep thud of a kick, a fat snare, three toms and a hi-hat that opens wide. Soul, funk and breaks.

kits.name: 808 boom
kits.description: The 808 with the kick's decay all the way up and its tone down: a long boom under a darker snare and long toms. Hip-hop, electro, Miami bass.

kits.name: 808 trap
kits.description: Trap's 808: a long sub-kick to play as a bass and a short kick for the punch, a bright snappy snare, the clap and tight hats for rolls.

kits.name: 909 house
kits.description: The 909 as house knows it: the round kick, the snare and clap on two and four, open hats on the off-beat and the ride.

kits.name: 909 techno
kits.description: The 909 tightened for techno: its attack kick and snare, short hats and toms, a short ride for driving sixteenths.

kits.name: 707 dance
kits.description: The 707's bright digital drums: punchy kick, crisp snare, a tambourine, the sound of 80s dance and early house.

kits.name: Machine percussion
kits.description: A drum machine's Latin percussion: congas, bongos, timbales, agogos, a quijada and whistles, in the bright digital colour of the 80s.

kits.name: 606 analog
kits.description: A small analog machine in the 606's mould, recorded by its owner: a thumpy kick, a noisy snare, sizzling hats and two toms. Acid and minimal.

kits.name: 80s digital
kits.description: An 80s digital drum machine's sampled kit: tight kick, big snare, clap and four toms. Pop, synth-pop and new wave.

kits.name: 80s electronic
kits.description: The same 80s machine's electronic side: processed kick and snare, synth toms and FM percussion. Electro-funk and synth-pop.

kits.name: 90s club
kits.description: A 90s groove box at the club: house kicks and snares, a fat clap, pop hats, congas, a reverse cymbal and a scratch.

kits.name: 90s studio
kits.description: A 90s groove box's studio kit: a real kick, a big gated snare, rock toms and acoustic hats. Pop, R&B and rock demos.

kits.name: Synth percussion
kits.description: Drums made on synthesizers, nothing recorded: sine kicks, noise snares and claps, metallic hats and pitched toms.

kits.name: Drum and bass
kits.description: Snares that crack at 170 bpm, a tight kick, fast hats and a ride for rolling breaks.

kits.name: Hardstyle
kits.description: Distorted, tuned kicks in G and F, a hardcore kick, punchy snares and a noise clap. Hardstyle and hardcore.

kits.name: Hip-hop
kits.description: A long and a short kick, hip-hop and R&B snares, a trap clap, a snap and a vinyl backspin.

kits.name: Future bass
kits.description: Bright, compressed kicks, wide synthetic claps and snares, and synth toms for future bass and pop drops.

kits.name: Electro lab
kits.description: Electronic drums and blips from a lab bench: a hollow kick, filtered snares, a fuzz tom, a wood block, pops, pings and chimes.

kits.name: Minimal
kits.description: Small, dry club sounds: two kicks, clicky snares and snaps, a family of thin hats and a bell. Minimal techno and microhouse.

kits.name: Body
kits.description: Everything a body plays: stomps for a kick, claps for a snare, snaps, chest and belly drums, a heel and a cheek pop.
